title: nightshift task result
description: The structured verdict a worker agent returns for one task. Passed to `claude --json-schema`. Note: this is the agent's CLAIM, not the decision. The runner independently re-runs the verify gates and its result is what determines whether the task is committed.

status.description: done = acceptance criteria met and verify passed locally. partial = real progress but not finished. blocked = needs a human decision; pair with blocker_question.

summary.description: What you actually changed and why, in a few sentences. This is read by a human at 8am with no other context.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths you created or modified.

verification_claim.description: Which verify commands you ran yourself and what they returned.

blocker_question.description: Required when status is blocked. One specific question a human can answer in a sentence. Not 'how should I do this?' but 'should orders without a customer_id be excluded or grouped under NULL?'
